name: Своя мастерская
approval_context: E1 uses ten atomic sheet-parts in the same four-role structure as the complete E0 candidate. The first guarded materials-construction/01-surfaces-stock sheet now has an immutable Drive-backed exact source with scope/style/era/readability self-review PASS and is pending the required E0↔E1 cross-era role review. Seven earlier source-rejected attempts remain provenance only. Nine E1 sheet-parts remain to be generated and reviewed.

preserved: olive/gray utilitarian ancestry with practical work lighting
replaced: ad-hoc hand-built construction with standardized industrial modules
open improvised cable runs with trays, harnesses and organized pipe racks
primarily manual mechanisms with hydraulics and electromechanical drives
individually fitted controls with grouped repeatable operator modules
isolated ad-hoc lamps with planned standardized lighting and signal families
added: standardized cabinets, service covers, brackets and connectors
hydraulic and electromechanical drive components with guards
monochrome and limited early color CRT hardware where functionally justified
industrial safety color coding and repeatable utility routing
transition_from_e0.why: The base has matured from a garage prototype into a standardized workshop with repeatable production, maintenance and operating procedures.
transition_from_e0.player_signal: More ordered construction, repeated module language, guarded assisted mechanisms, safety coding, organized utilities and denser but still period-appropriate controls.

exact_sha_visual_review.method: Exact untouched source bytes measured locally, archived to Drive, and visually reviewed against the canonical E1 eight-specimen spec and style contract. Generation predated the explicit conversational bridge merge and used the user's explicit complete eight-item instruction; all subsequent guarded imagegen calls use the merged bridge.

usage.reference_strategy: Use materials-construction/01-surfaces-stock only as an exact-SHA E1 candidate pending the matching E0↔E1 cross-era materials-role review. Generate materials-construction/02-joints-repairs next through the merged explicit conversational imagegen bridge, then archive and review exact bytes before any later E1 sheet. All seven rejected surfaces-stock outputs remain provenance only and must not be used as visual evidence. Use the complete exact-SHA E0 candidate set only as lineage/comparison evidence for E0↔E1 cross-era review; do not use previous broad E1 reference boards.
usage.system_separation: Physical hardware/materials belong in art; dynamic glow, active screens/data, motion, sparks, fields and temporary FX remain code-owned unless explicitly scoped otherwise.
